archetypes.name: issue-flow
archetypes.rationale: Diff changes a multi-step stall-recovery to /larch:issue integration with dry-run, dev-clone, batch-output, and dedup branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the Step 18a procedure now composes and files the headed issue input in the intended order across dev-clone, dry-run, consumer, and terminal-class paths. Pay special attention to whether the documented batch stdout normalization can actually provide canonical issue keys for later bug-comment targeting. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-regex
archetypes.rationale: The helper change replaces shell glob matching with a bash regex sanitizer that must preserve production tokens while rejecting injected suffixes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the `safe_step_value` grammar and its shell implementation for full-string matching, bash compatibility, and unintended acceptance or rejection of documented stall-step tokens. Check that the added fixtures exercise the riskiest branches without masking regex or quoting mistakes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: orchestrator-docs
archetypes.rationale: The live behavior is partly encoded as orchestrator-facing markdown, so prose precision and script-contract alignment are critical.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the changed markdown procedure as executable workflow guidance, not ordinary documentation. Verify that command ordering, file names, one-line command constraints, and ownership boundaries align with the helper scripts and structure-test pins. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
